entry: Figma: agent bound 59 unbound padding, gap and radius values in 7 components to existing Spacing and Radius variables (user-approved). Only exact value matches were bound, except 6 pill and circle radii (999 or 10) moved to radius/full (9999), which renders identically. Re-scan of all 24 library components found 0 unbound padding, gap or radius values.
Decisions: add typography primitives; build Avatar, Avatar Badge, Company Avatar and Paddle Button; sync full spacing and radius scales; radius changes and proposed component map accepted.

Token sync: tokens.css gains 50 tokens (typography primitives, full spacing and radius); text tokens reference primitives; surface/default aliases match Figma; Inter and IBM Plex Mono 300 added to the font URL on 4 entry pages; tokens.css cache revision bumped to 20261024-token-sync. Checks: token-diff 173/173 Figma variables match; resolve-tokens shows no resolved value change for any of the 198 existing tokens in either theme; lint passes; npm test 190/191 with the one failure pre-existing (resume-context date fixture); typecheck could not run in the agent's Linux shell. Not verified: Google Fonts response and rendered weight in a browser.

Designer updated Figma Typography: font-weight/normal (300) renamed to light, new normal (400); serif styles rebound to normal (closes H-08); Type/Meta changed from Plex Mono Light to Regular. Code follows: --nc-font-weight-light 300 and --nc-font-weight-normal 400, serif and Meta weights reference normal, Plex Mono URL back to 400 only. Checks: token-diff 174/174; text-style-check 17/17 including loaded weights; versus HEAD the only resolved value change is --nc-type-meta-weight 300 to 400.

Component sync batch 1 (C-01 Load Spinner, C-02 Status-Badge, C-04 Input Label): components.css padding and offsets tokenized, .nc-field__label--sm added, components.css cache revision bumped to 20261024-component-sync. Added design-sync/preview.html and scripts/shot.mjs; evidence in design-sync/evidence/batch-1.*. Measured sizes within 1px of Figma in both themes.

Browser check on localhost: Inter 300 loads from Google Fonts and renders on the Resume Builder. Fixed two off-scale weights found there: the app heading and loading status (DM Serif Display at 600, faux bold) now use --nc-type-h1-weight and --nc-type-h3-weight (400); .nc-field__description now uses --nc-type-body-default-weight (300) instead of 400. Resume document and export serif weights left as-is (document formatting stays local). components.css cache revision bumped to 20261024-label-weight. Re-check: no visible text on the page at an off-scale weight.

Component sync batch 2 (C-05 Pill Tab Item, C-14 Pill-Tabs, C-06 Step Progress Item, C-07 Chip): pill tabs gain .nc-pill-tabs--lg; step items default to Figma Lg with .nc-step--sm and Sm below 600px in the indicator; chip padding corrected for Figma inside strokes. Pill-Tabs (C-14) done early since its Lg size lives on the group. New Figma item H-09. components.css cache revision 20261024-batch-2. Evidence in design-sync/evidence/batch-2.*; Resume Builder step bar checked in the browser at 385px and 1280px.

Designer set Pill Tab Item Lg to 34px (closes H-09). Code now derives pill tab height from a --nc-pill-tabs-height group variable (28px Sm, 40px Lg) so the group height is the single spec; verified 28/22 and 40/34 at 1280px.

Designer excluded the Pill-Tabs border from layout; tab items are now 24px (Sm) and 36px (Lg) inside 28/40px groups. Code follows: group padding is 2px minus the 1px border, tabs are group height minus 4px, and tab labels no longer wrap (user request). Verified Sm 28/24 and Lg 40/36 in the browser, including at 385px. components.css cache revision 20261024-pill-tabs; batch-2 evidence re-captured.

Component sync batch 3 (C-08 Button, C-09 Switch-Mode, C-10 MainNavItem): buttons now 40/28px (were 42/30) with side padding minus the border, new .nc-button--icon-only; Switch-Mode already matched; nav item padding tokenized. components.css and navigation.css cache revisions 20261024-batch-3. New Figma item H-10. Evidence in design-sync/evidence/batch-3.*; Resume Builder checked at 1280px.

Component sync batch 4 (C-15 Step Progress Indicator, C-16 TextField, C-17 TextArea): shared input padding corrected for the inside stroke, disabled inputs get @action/disabled/bg with no border, error border uses @danger/border, input radius and border tokens match Figma bindings, field spacing tokenized. components.css cache revision 20261024-batch-4. New Figma item H-11. Evidence in design-sync/evidence/batch-4.*; Resume Builder fields checked in the browser.

TextField Action R: the audit had marked it unused, but Prospect Tracker's Job URL field implements it locally (user caught this). Promoted to shared .nc-input-group / .nc-input-group__action (Action L and R), switched ui.js to it and removed the local job-url-control CSS. Prospect Tracker styles.css, bootstrap.js, app.js and ui.js cache revisions 20261024-input-action; components.css 20261024-input-action. Tests 190/191 (pre-existing failure), lint clean.

Built TextField Icon R at the user's request: shared .nc-input-group__icon with padding and position rules for icon alone and icon plus Action R, disabled color. components.css cache revision 20261024-input-icon. New Figma item H-12 (icon color unbound).
Designer direction: Icon R sits to the right of Action R. Code updated (icon always at the end, link shifts left 8px past it). Figma variants disagree on the order; added to H-12.

Designer fixed TextField content order (Icon R after Action R in all five variants, verified). Icon R color could not be verified through the API. H-10 (mobile nav padding) and H-11 (TextArea 98 vs 96) re-checked: unchanged, still open.

Designer fixed H-11 (TextArea 98px in all states; code min-height 96 -> 98) and partly H-10 (mobile nav radius/md in all states; code mobile default radius set to md, padding tokenized). Selected mobile padding 6 vs 4 still open pending designer confirmation. components.css and navigation.css cache revisions 20261024-figma-fixes.

Designer fixed H-10 (mobile nav items 6px padding and radius/md in all states); code follows for mobile and the compact account menu. H-12 closed as a false positive: Icon R is bound to text/secondary (action/disabled/fg when disabled), which the API could not read inside the instance. navigation.css cache revision 20261024-nav-mobile.

Component sync batch 5 (C-18 Select, C-19 Checkbox, C-20 Radio): Select chevron positioned and padded like TextField Icon R; new .nc-choice label composite for Checkbox and Radio (gap 8/6, Input Label type, disabled label color). Controls already matched. components.css cache revision 20261024-batch-5. Open question: Prospect Tracker date filter radio labels. Evidence in design-sync/evidence/batch-5.*.

Prospect Tracker date filter range radios switched to the shared Radio Sm label (.nc-choice--sm); local font-size and gap removed from .board-date-option. Cache revisions: date-filter.js, ui.js, app.js, bootstrap.js and styles.css 20261024-radio-label. Tests 190/191 (pre-existing failure), lint clean.

Component sync batch 6 (C-21 Alert, C-22 Toast, C-03 Avatar Badge): alert and toast padding corrected for the inside stroke (alerts were 42px tall), radius @radius/lg; new .nc-avatar-badge. components.css cache revision 20261024-batch-6. New Figma item H-13 (badge ring bound to a deleted variable). Evidence in design-sync/evidence/batch-6.*.
Designer rebound the Avatar Badge ring to surface/default (closes H-13, verified).

Component sync batch 7 (C-11 Company Avatar, C-12 Avatar, C-13 Paddle Button, C-23 Prospect Card, C-24 Main Navigation Header): new .nc-avatar (with company and badge variants) and .nc-paddle; Prospect Card restructured to Figma (avatar header, title, badge and date row, hover grip) in ui.js and styles.css; header spacing tokenized. New preview-tracker.html for tracker-styled components. Cache revisions: components.css and navigation.css 20261024-batch-7; Prospect Tracker ui/app/bootstrap/styles 20261024-batch-7. New Figma items H-14 and H-15. Tests 190/191 (pre-existing failure), lint clean. All 24 components synced.

Typecheck fix: the companyAvatar helper had been inserted between el()'s JSDoc and the function, detaching el's types (2 TS7006 errors reported by the user). Moved the helper above the JSDoc. tsc --noEmit (TypeScript 7.0.2, Linux binary installed outside the repo) now passes; tests 190/191 (pre-existing failure); lint clean.
